theme_and_archetype.archetype: Custom: Official Ledger & Seal (Variant of Swiss/Authority)
theme_and_archetype.description: A high-trust, official 'letterhead and seal' identity. Avoids generic SaaS tropes (no cream+serif+terracotta, no near-black+neon-accent). Heavy reliance on real paper aesthetics, precise grid hairlines, and stamping motifs to convey government compliance, authority, and reliability.

primary.name: Primary Ink
primary.usage: Deep indigo for primary text, major headings, dark contrast blocks, and primary CTAs. Simulates wet ink.

background.name: Background Paper
background.usage: Warmer and greyer than generic cream. Represents real bond paper. Used as the universal page background.

accent_red.name: Seal Red
accent_red.usage: Used ONLY for stamps, status marks, penalty callouts, and extremely urgent CTAs. Never as a base color or generic button color.

accent_gold.name: Marigold Gold
accent_gold.usage: Culturally resonant accent for links, highlights, and secondary interactive states.

success.name: Approval Green
success.usage: Used for success states, approved marks, and positive tick marks in checklists.

neutral.name: Slate
neutral.usage: Secondary text, metadata, and 1px hairline rules for the ledger layout.

display.usage: Used EXCLUSIVELY for H1 and H2 headings. Heavy slab-serif to convey institutional authority.

body.usage: Clean grotesk for all body text, paragraphs, and UI elements. Plain, active, highly readable.

monospace.usage: Used for reference numbers, filing IDs, timestamps, and quotes to simulate government form numbers.

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Generous spacing (p-8 to p-24) to allow the 'paper' to breathe. Standard tailwind scale.

ledger_hairlines.description: Thin 1px hairline rules between sections to create a ledger-paper feel.
ledger_hairlines.implementation: Use `border-t border-b border-[#5B6472]/20` on major sections and list items.

layout_and_spacing.container: Max width 7xl (max-w-7xl) centered with mx-auto, keeping a structured column feel.
layout_and_spacing.alignment: Strict left-alignment for dense content, mimicking official documents. Center alignment only for hero or specific break-out quotes.

ink_stamp_seal.usage: Used sparingly (once prominently per page) to house trust stats (e.g., '500+ Filings', 'GST Registered').
ink_stamp_seal.visuals: SVG circular text path, border-dashed or rigged edges, colored in #C1272D (Seal Red) or #12203D (Primary Ink).
ink_stamp_seal.motion: Animates in on scroll (scale up + slight rotation).

filing_tab_nav.description: Category/pillar navigation styled as filing folder tabs.
filing_tab_nav.implementation: Tabs should have a straight bottom, rounded top corners (`rounded-t-lg`), and connect seamlessly with the content border below them. Active tab matches content background, inactive tabs are slightly darker or transparent with bottom borders.

checklist_steps.description: Process/step sections shown as a checklist with tick states.
checklist_steps.implementation: Do not use numbered circles. Use square checkbox icons (☐ for upcoming, ☑ in #1E5631 for completed). Connect with a vertical hairline border.

service_cards.implementation: Background #FFFFFF or slightly lighter than #F7F4EC. Subtle edge shadow (`shadow-sm`). Include a small static seal mark (SVG) in the corner. Must show starting price directly on the card.
service_cards.hover_state: Subtle -translate-y-1 with slightly increased shadow. Do not make it 'glow'.

buttons.primary: Solid #12203D background, white text. Or #C1272D for urgent actions.
buttons.hover_animation: Stamp-down effect: On hover, button scales down slightly (`scale-95`) and rotates minimally (`rotate-1` or `-rotate-1`) to simulate a hand stamping paper.

penalty_callout.implementation: Bordered box with a left red accent (`border-l-4 border-[#C1272D]`), light red background tint, and monospace citation of the penalty.

motion.global: Snappy, mechanical, official. Avoid smooth, floating SaaS animations.
motion.seal_scroll: opacity-0 scale-50 rotate-[-15deg] to opacity-100 scale-100 rotate-0 transition-all duration-500 ease-out

image_urls.description: Indian professionals in an office presentation. Good for About Us or Homepage Hero.
Close up of hand signing document. Perfect for the Registration and Protection service pages.
Smiling diverse team in modern office. Use for 'Dedicated Manager' sections.

copy_guidelines.voice: Plain, active, specific. Avoid filler adjectives.
copy_guidelines.trust_markers: Every CTA must be accompanied by a trust marker (e.g., 'No hidden fees', 'Government recognized', 'Takes 5 minutes').

instructions_to_main_agent.tailwind_config: You MUST customize tailwind.config.js to include the exact hex codes provided in 'colors'. Add 'Fraunces' and 'IBM Plex Mono' to the font family config.
instructions_to_main_agent.testing_attributes: All interactive elements (buttons, form inputs, tabs, quote steps) MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute in kebab-case. Example: data-testid='submit-gst-form'.
instructions_to_main_agent.component_creation: Build custom HTML/Tailwind components for the Filing Tabs, Service Cards, and Ink Stamps. Do not rely on generic shadcn cards if they conflict with the 'paper' styling.
instructions_to_main_agent.page_structure: Ensure all 40+ required pages or templates (Homepage, 5 Pillar Hubs, Service page templates, Quote form, About, Reviews, Contact) follow the exact ledger layout structure.
instructions_to_main_agent.multi_step_quote: Implement a progressive form with discrete steps, using a ledger hairline progress indicator. Use monospace font for the generated quote reference ID.
